notes: 24 unseen examples not used during prompt tuning.
Covers edge cases required by the M10 checklist.
All examples were labeled independently of evaluation results.
Do not tune prompts against this set — it is the holdout.

emails.subject: This week in tech: AI, crypto, and more
emails.body: Welcome to your weekly digest. This week: OpenAI releases new model, Bitcoin hits new high, and Apple announces spatial computing update. No action needed — just read and enjoy.
emails.rationale: Informational newsletter with no request.

emails.subject: Flash sale: 50% off all plans — today only!
emails.body: Don't miss our biggest sale of the year. Use code SAVE50 at checkout. Offer expires midnight. This is a promotional message.
emails.rationale: Promotional email. Urgency language ('today only', 'expires midnight') does not make it actionable for the recipient.

emails.subject: Optional: join our lunch-and-learn on Friday
emails.body: Hi team, we are running an optional lunch-and-learn on Friday at noon. Feel free to join if you are available — no RSVP needed. Pizza will be provided.
emails.rationale: Explicitly optional. No RSVP required. 'Feel free to join' is not a task request.

emails.subject: Meeting rescheduled to Thursday 3 PM
emails.body: Hi, the product sync has been moved from Wednesday 2 PM to Thursday 3 PM. Your calendar invite has been updated. No reply needed.
emails.rationale: Meeting change notification. No reply or action explicitly required.

emails.subject: Exciting news: we just launched version 3.0!
emails.body: We are thrilled to announce the launch of version 3.0 of our platform. Check out the release notes at our blog. No action is required on your part.
emails.rationale: Excitement language but explicitly informational. No action required.

emails.subject: Your order #4821 has shipped
emails.body: Good news! Your order has been dispatched and will arrive in 3-5 business days. Track your package at the link below. No action needed.
emails.rationale: Order confirmation. No task for the recipient.

emails.subject: URGENT: Scheduled server maintenance tonight
emails.body: Please be aware that we will be performing scheduled server maintenance tonight from 11 PM to 2 AM. There is no action required from you. Systems will be temporarily unavailable during this window.
emails.rationale: URGENT in subject but body explicitly states no action required. Informational.

emails.subject: Critical: new compliance update effective next quarter
emails.body: FYI — our legal team has updated the compliance documentation following new regulations effective Q1 next year. The changes are minor and do not require any action from you at this time. Full details attached.
emails.rationale: Critical/FYI email that explicitly states no action required. Urgency word in subject does not override body intent.

emails.subject: Can you review the onboarding doc?
emails.body: Hi, when you get a chance, could you review the updated onboarding document and let me know if anything is missing? There is no rush on this.
emails.rationale: Routine review task. Explicitly 'no rush'. No deadline.

emails.subject: Your feedback on our service
emails.body: We would love to hear your thoughts on our service. Please fill in the short survey when you have a moment. It takes about 2 minutes.
emails.rationale: Soft request with no deadline. Routine.

emails.subject: Please send the meeting notes from today
emails.body: Hi, could you send over the notes from this morning's standup when you get a chance? The team needs them for the wiki.
emails.rationale: Simple task request. No explicit deadline.

emails.subject: Invoice #INV-2089 due 2026-10-31
emails.body: Please process payment for invoice INV-2089 totalling $4,200 by 2026-10-31. Late payments incur a 2% monthly fee. Bank details are in the attachment.
emails.rationale: Clear payment task with explicit ISO deadline date.

emails.subject: Fix the checkout crash before 2026-11-03
emails.body: The checkout page crashes for users on iOS 17 when they apply a discount code. This must be fixed before our November 3rd campaign launch. Please prioritise.
emails.rationale: Explicit bug fix with a clear deadline tied to a campaign.

emails.subject: Quarterly report due October 28
emails.body: Reminder: the Q3 financial report must be submitted to the board by October 28. Please ensure all sections are complete and reviewed before submission.
emails.rationale: Report submission with explicit deadline.

emails.subject: Your invoice was due last Friday
emails.body: This is a reminder that invoice INV-2001 was due last Friday. Please arrange payment as soon as possible to avoid service interruption.
emails.rationale: Actionable payment task but 'last Friday' is a relative/past date — AMBIGUOUS deadline state means policy routes to clarification, not auto-create. Confirmation path expected.

emails.subject: Deploy the hotfix sometime this week
emails.body: We need the authentication hotfix deployed to production sometime this week. The exact day is flexible but it should not slip past the weekend.
emails.rationale: Actionable with meaningful impact but 'sometime this week' is vague — AMBIGUOUS deadline. Policy routes to clarification.

emails.subject: CRITICAL: production database is down
emails.body: The primary database cluster has gone offline. All customer-facing services are returning 500 errors. DBA team is investigating but needs your help immediately.
emails.rationale: Confirmed production outage. 'Immediately' is an urgency signal not a calendar date. Under current policy P0+AMBIGUOUS → CLARIFY_DEADLINE. Human must confirm timeline before task is auto-created.

emails.subject: Active security breach — unauthorized access detected
emails.body: Our SIEM has flagged unauthorized access to the admin console from an unknown IP. Session tokens may be compromised. Please revoke all active sessions and rotate credentials now.
emails.rationale: Active security incident but body contains no date reference — 'now' is not matched as relative. P0+NONE → SUMMARIZE_ONLY under current policy. A dedicated incident-response channel is more appropriate than auto-scheduling.

emails.subject: Please update the API docs ASAP
emails.body: The API documentation is outdated and customers are raising support tickets. Please update it as soon as possible.
emails.rationale: ASAP is vague — no calendar date. Policy routes to CLARIFY_DEADLINE for the deadline, but since it's P2 without a clear date, expect NO_ACTION/clarify path.

emails.subject: Complete the security audit by end of Q4
emails.body: We need to complete the annual security audit before end of Q4. Please schedule the kick-off meeting and coordinate with the security team.
emails.rationale: 'End of Q4' is vague without knowing the year and exact date. AMBIGUOUS deadline — policy routes to clarification.

emails.subject: Please join our webinar next Tuesday
emails.body: We would love to have you at our webinar next Tuesday at 2 PM. Please register if you are interested — attendance is optional and sessions will be recorded.
emails.rationale: Uses 'please' but explicitly states optional attendance. No task obligation.

emails.subject: Weekly update + action needed on contract
emails.body: Hi team, great work this week — we hit 98% uptime. On another note, the vendor contract renewal is due for signature by 2026-10-29. Please review and sign via DocuSign. Also, the team lunch is Friday — optional.
emails.rationale: Mixed informational and actionable content. The contract deadline (2026-10-29) is explicit and makes this P1 actionable.

emails.subject: URGENT: Read this important policy update
emails.body: Please read the updated remote work policy attached. There is no action required — the changes are minor and take effect next quarter. Just be aware of section 4.2 on expense reporting.
emails.rationale: URGENT in subject, but body states no action required. FYI-only. Model should not be fooled by subject line urgency.

emails.subject: Fix the data export bug
emails.body: The CSV export is truncating rows for accounts with more than 10,000 records. This is affecting enterprise customers. Please investigate and fix.
emails.rationale: Actionable P1 bug but no deadline mentioned. Current policy: P1 without deadline → SUMMARIZE_ONLY.
